answer_1.quote: Simultaneous speech translation converts input speech into translation output before the speech input utterance ends, enabling low-latency interaction.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates text and speech outputs for simultaneous speech-to-speech translation, including target-language discrete speech tokens synthesized into speech via a vocoder.

answer_2.quote: ASR-BLEU For Simul-S2ST, the ASR-BLEU toolkit was used to evaluate the translation quality, which transcribes the synthesised speech into text before calculating SacreBLEU with the reference text.
